definitions.explanation: Competitive gymnastics performed on apparatus such as the vault, parallel bars, rings, horizontal bar, balance beam, and uneven bars. Distinguished from rhythmic gymnastics ({新体操|しんたいそう}) and general floor-based exercise.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{器械体操|きかいたいそう}を{習|なら}っている。
examples.english: My daughter is learning artistic gymnastics.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{器械体操|きかいたいそう}の{選手|せんしゅ}としてオリンピックに{出場|しゅつじょう}した。
examples.english: He competed in the Olympics as an artistic gymnast.

examples.japanese: {器械体操|きかいたいそう}では{鉄棒|てつぼう}や{平行棒|へいこうぼう}などの{種目|しゅもく}がある。
examples.english: Artistic gymnastics has events such as the horizontal bar and parallel bars.

notes:
Compound of {器械|きかい} (apparatus) + {体操|たいそう} (gymnastics, exercise). Refers to the form of gymnastics seen at the Olympics, performed on six (men's) or four (women's) pieces of apparatus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {器械体操|きかいたいそう}の{選手|せんしゅ}: artistic gymnast
- {器械体操|きかいたいそう}{部|ぶ}: gymnastics club
- {器械体操|きかいたいそう}の{大会|たいかい}: gymnastics competition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新体操|しんたいそう}: rhythmic gymnastics — uses ribbon, ball, hoop, rope, or clubs
- {体操|たいそう}: gymnastics, calisthenics — general term, includes everyday exercise
- {床運動|ゆかうんどう}: floor exercise — one event within artistic gymnastics
